subject: Intermodal BOL split causing barge delay — need reconciled manifest
messages:
From: Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@bluegate-logistics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Expo booth crates - barge held for documentation mismatch

Hi Grace,

Quick heads up from the carrier: the southbound barge that was carrying two of the intermodal containers for your booth has been held at the Port of Oakland pending customs review. The issue is that the original shipment was moved across two BOLs at origin — one for "crate A" and one for "crate B" — but the manifest we received at the terminal shows them as a single combined shipment. That mismatch triggers a documentation check and they won't release to barge until it's reconciled.

I'm attaching the barge notice and the split BOL pages so you can see the discrepancy. Action items I can take immediately if you want:
- Submit a combined manifest to terminal ops (I can upload if you confirm)
- Request an urgent physical inspection (usually adds 8-12 hours)
- Rebook to the next available barge window (tomorrow evening) if release can't be cleared today

Let me know which you'd prefer. If you want me to push the manifest now, reply with approval and I'll take it.

Regards,
Tomasz Nowak
Senior Ops Manager
BlueGate Logistics
Phone: +1 510 555 0199

Attachments: barge_notice_0628.pdf; BOL_split_page1.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@bluegate-logistics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ExpoCorp Events <logistics@expocorp.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Expo booth crates - barge held for documentation mismatch

Tomasz — thanks for the quick flag. Please proceed to submit the combined manifest on our behalf (upload to terminal ops) and request a physical inspection. We prefer the inspection route first to avoid rebooking if possible.

Key constraints from our side:
- Crate B contains fragile demo hardware; we need proof of inspection before offloading to confirm no damage.
- ExpoCorp needs exact ETA for booth build — if we miss the Thursday noon load-in window we'll need to escalate for overtime labor.

Jonas / Marissa — looping you both in for visibility. Jonas, can you confirm whether we should authorize any additional inspection fee (up to $450) if the terminal requests it? Marissa, please inform ExpoCorp logistics that we may shift the arrival window and ask for flexibility on the load-in slot.

Grace O'Connor
Field Marketing Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
+1 415 555 0137
From: Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@bluegate-logistics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Expo booth crates - barge held for documentation mismatch

Grace, Jonas — manifest uploaded to terminal ops at 08:48 PT (reference: TMZ-OP-6142). Terminal acknowledged receipt but they still require a certified copy of the original combined BOL from the origin carrier. I attached the split BOL pages we have — they asked we either:

1) provide a certified combined BOL from the origin hauler (fastest if origin carrier can reissue), or
2) coordinate a one-off terminal reconciliation with a signed affidavit from the shipper and recipient (longer manual process).

If you want to avoid the affidavit process I recommend option 1. If origin carrier is slow, option 2 will typically clear within 12-18 hours but requires signatures and the inspection to be scheduled.

Also note: current barge window is missed for tonight; next barge departure is 2026-07-01 18:00 PT. If cleared by 14:00 today we'll still make that slot; otherwise we'll be pushed to 07-02 and incur an extra drayage layover cost.

Attachments: BOL_split_page1.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@bluegate-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ExpoCorp Events <logistics@expocorp.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: RE: Expo booth crates - barge held for documentation mismatch

Thanks, Tomasz. I just spoke with the origin carrier (Pacific Haul) and they're able to reissue a certified combined BOL but it will take ~4 hours to process and courier back to us. Please hold the inspection request for now — if Pacific Haul can get that combined BOL to you by 14:00 PT, we should make the 18:00 barge.

Marissa — please tell ExpoCorp to tentatively hold our Thursday noon load-in as "pending" and confirm whether they have an alternate crew on call in case we slide into the 07-02 slot. We may need an overtime window.

Action plan summarized: 
- Pacific Haul to issue certified combined BOL (ETA to Tomasz 13:45 PT)
- Tomasz to deliver combined BOL to terminal ops and confirm release
- If release confirmed by 14:00 PT, proceed with 18:00 barge; otherwise rebook and expect extra layover charges

Jonas Weber
Sr. Logistics Program Manager (Events)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: ExpoCorp Events <logistics@expocorp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@bluegate-logistics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermodal BOL split causing barge delay — need reconciled manifest

Hi team — ExpoCorp confirmed they can keep the Thursday noon slot tentatively and have an alternate crew on call for Friday evening if needed. They asked that we confirm final ETA by 18:00 PT today so they can lock staffing.

Grace/Jonas/Tomasz — please update with the terminal confirmation ASAP. If additional inspection fees are needed, please route approvals to finance-ops for payment (Jonas, please include an expectation of cost).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Events Operations Specialist
Redwood Inference
